_note: 版式槽位说明:AI 只需要给每个槽一个取数表达式或一句文案,写进 .df 的「① 槽位」。坐标、配色、数字格式化、空态都由版式负责。maxLen 按档位给,单位是中文字数(英文约 1.8 倍字符),超出会以「…」截断。

summary.zh-CN: 数字 + 一条近期走势线;给了涨跌幅就按涨跌上色,否则用源色
summary.en-US: A number + its recent shape; coloured by change when given, accent otherwise

pick.zh-CN: 要看「最近是往上还是往下」的量:行情、体重、访问量、温度
pick.en-US: Anything where the recent direction matters: prices, weight, traffic, temperature

meaning.zh-CN: 组件名(第一行):有对象写对象名,没有就写功能名
meaning.en-US: Widget name (first line): the object's name, or what it shows

meaning.zh-CN: 数字格式:auto 千分位 + 最多两位小数 · int 取整 · 1dp / 2dp 固定小数 · compact 中文万 / 亿、英文 K / M / B · raw 原样显示
meaning.en-US: Number format: auto (grouping, up to 2 decimals) · int · 1dp / 2dp · compact (万/亿 in Chinese, K/M/B otherwise) · raw (as given)

meaning.zh-CN: 走势:数字数组,按时间从旧到新,最后一个 = 现在。取最后 16 个点;不足 16 个时左边补平
meaning.en-US: History: an array of numbers, oldest first, last = now. The last 16 points are drawn; fewer are padded flat on the left

whenEmpty.en-US: A skeleton block in the chart area

meaning.zh-CN: 涨跌幅 %(可选)。给了:数字下方显示并按涨跌上色走势线;不给:走势线用源色
meaning.en-US: Change in percent (optional). Given: shown under the number and colours the line; omitted: the line uses the accent

meaning.zh-CN: 数字下方一句:时间范围或比较对象
meaning.en-US: Line under the number: the time range or the comparison

meaning.zh-CN: 时效锚(右上角):数据是什么时候取到的,当天 HH:mm、跨天 MM-dd HH:mm;纯本地计算的组件留空
meaning.en-US: Freshness stamp (top right): when the data was fetched — HH:mm today, MM-dd HH:mm otherwise; leave empty for purely local widgets

whenEmpty.zh-CN: 不显示,组件名占满整行
whenEmpty.en-US: Hidden; the name takes the full row

meaning.zh-CN: 源色:身份点与强调色。只选名字;财经涨跌类用 graphite(红绿已被涨跌占用)
meaning.en-US: Accent: the identity dot and highlight colour. Pick a name; use graphite for up/down finance widgets (red/green already mean up/down)
